entities.summary: Byron Froese is a Canadian professional ice hockey player for Lokomotiv Yaroslavl of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Froese was selected in the fourth round, 119th overall, by Chicago Blackhawks in the 2009 NHL Entry Draft. Froese has previously played for Toronto Maple Leafs, Tampa Bay Lightning, Montreal Canadiens, Calgary Flames and Vegas Golden Knights of the National Hockey League (NHL).
